record.paper_title: Open Problems on Ultrafilters and Some Connections to the Continuum
record.context_brief: Asymmetric cuts at the first symmetric cut
record.original_question: Let D be a regular ultrafilter on I, and let C(D) be the cut spectrum of (ω,<)^I/D. Suppose C(D) is nonempty and κ ≤ |I| is the least regular cardinal for which the symmetric cut (κ,κ) belongs to C(D). For which cardinals μ < κ can the asymmetric cut (κ,μ) also belong to C(D)?

evidence.quote: Problem 1.10. Suppose that D is an ultrafilter on I and C(D) != ∅ ... For which ... μ < κ ...

artifact.status_search_result: The problem belongs to the program of Malliaris and Shelah on cofinality spectrum problems and cut spectra of regular ultrafilters. Known results characterize when $C(D)=\emptyset$ (equivalent to $\lambda^+$-goodness/treetops) and rule out symmetric cuts below certain thresholds, but a description of which asymmetric cuts $(\kappa,\mu)$ with $\mu<\kappa$ can accompany the least symmetric cut $(\kappa,\kappa)$ does not appear to be settled in the available literature. No published resolution was located.

status_evidence.title: Cofinality spectrum theorems in model theory, set theory and general topology
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of C(D)=∅ via treetops/goodness; analysis of symmetric and asymmetric cuts in regular ultrapowers.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational framework for C(D); no explicit resolution of the asymmetric-cut question at the least symmetric cut.

status_evidence.title: Model-theoretic applications of cofinality spectrum problems
status_evidence.snippet: Further development of cut spectrum theory for regular ultrafilters.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work continues to study C(D) but the specific question about (κ,μ) with μ<κ at the least symmetric κ remains open.
